$comment: THRESHOLD PARTITION (Mission 1.85.5). The Mission 1.85.4 threshold decision package, unchanged, partitioned by the reference each criterion needs. No value was lowered and nothing is authorised: every entry is PROPOSED_NOT_AUTHORISED until the operator records a separate decision. A pilot criterion reads its value against a SINGLE_HUMAN_REFERENCE on DEVELOPMENT and yields a PILOT_NOT_CERTIFICATION reading, never PASS or FAIL.
pilot_outcome_rule: for each AUTHORISED pilot criterion report PILOT_WITHIN_PROPOSED_BOUND, PILOT_OUTSIDE_PROPOSED_BOUND or PILOT_INSUFFICIENT_SUPPORT, all under RESULT_SCOPE = DEVELOPMENT_PILOT and REFERENCE_STRENGTH = SINGLE_HUMAN_REFERENCE; no pilot reading is a PASS, a FAIL or a certification
operator_options_per_pilot_item: REVISE_BEFORE_THE_PILOT_RUN (state the new value and why, before any pilot result)
